column1: # Protocol=41
# Protocol 41 adds ID81 compact sonic-boom cone and supports independent pod STABILIZE requests.
# Protocol 40 adds the authoritative grounded flag to ID70 snapshots for far-render wreck contact smoke.
# Protocol 39 adds the authoritative fuselage-impact time to ID70 snapshots and native aircraft state; WreckSections definitions describe four fuselage fragments.

# Protocol 38 adds cycle direction to ID65; pylon Counts in ID73/74 JSON; ID70 snapshots and native entity state carry aircraft wing-loss mask, start tick and inherited momentum. Packet IDs unchanged.
# Protocol 36 adds ID80: bounded Project Rose friendly occupied vehicle UUID snapshots; ID63 adds AIR_MISSILE and AIRCRAFT_BREAKUP recipes.

# Protocol 35 adds aircraft countermeasure definition data, movement chaff bit512 and optional opticalZoom, two synchronized vehicle INTs, and configured AAM guidance/lock state. Packet IDs remain unchanged.
# Superb Warfare packet/schema manifest. Protocol=41. Discriminators are exact for this protocol.

# Protocol 34 adds FAR_VEHICLE and vehicleUuid to ID63; ID74 snapshots include bounded fired-store counts, and ID2 definitions include authored gear-door hinges, launch offsets and station fire exclusions. Packet IDs are unchanged.
# Protocol 33 adds aircraft surface module geometry and native articulation channels to vehicle definitions.
# Protocol 32 removes forced cover streaming and terrain draw gates; IDs75-78 retain their layouts with empty terrain plans. Normal terrain depth provides occlusion.
# Protocol 31 adds bounded visible-vehicle priorities and camera offsets to ID75; vehicle membership and chunk selection remain server-owned.
# Protocol 30 uses five-times-distance acquisition with retained membership and raises terrain collections to 2048 chunks; packet IDs and field layouts are unchanged.
# Protocol 29 adds optional single aircraft mounts to ID74 armament definition snapshots; paired mounts and packet IDs are unchanged.
# Protocol 27 acknowledges received terrain for snapshot delivery; camera-specific section meshes guard every far draw.
# Protocol 26 scopes ID70 to terrain token/revision and adds bounded terrain request/plan/chunk/readiness IDs75-78.
# Protocol 25 replaces ID41 hold-to-dismount with authenticated double-tap physical edges.
# Protocol 24 appends gesture-qualified inversion request metadata to pilot intent IDs 71/72.
# Protocol 21 adds accepted wheel braking to fixed-wing entity-data instruments (schema 3).
# Aircraft limits: AIRCRAFT_REQUEST=16384/32/4096/0/0/0; AIRCRAFT_STATE=262144/32/65536/0/0/0
# Far vehicle limits: FAR_RENDER=262144/256/8192/0/0/0; FAR_TERRAIN=1048576/2048/256/0/0/0; FAR_TERRAIN_CONTROL=32768/2048/256/0/0/0
# limits columns are maxWireBytes/maxCollectionElements/maxStringChars/maxNbtBytes/maxCompressedBytes/maxDecompressedBytes.
# FiredVisualMessage frame-reference names are additionally capped at 128 characters and slot indexes at 2047.
